subject: gk
question:
Consider the given the values and answer the question that follows.

GNP at market prices = ₹15,50,113 crore

Indirect taxes = ₹1,75,386 crore

Subsidies = ₹38,504

Net factor income from abroad = (-)₹13,439

What will be the value of GDP at factor cost?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹14,26,670**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

GDP at factor cost = GNP at market prices - Indirect taxes + Subsidies - Net factor income from abroad

**Calculation**

 
• 
 
**Substitute the given values:**

 
GDP at factor cost = ₹15,50,113 crore - ₹1,75,386 crore + ₹38,504 crore - (-₹13,439 crore)

 
 
• 
 
**Simplify the equation:**

 
GDP at factor cost = ₹15,50,113 crore - ₹1,75,386 crore + ₹38,504 crore + ₹13,439 crore

 
 
• 
 
**Perform the calculations from left to right:**

 
 
• ₹15,50,113 crore - ₹1,75,386 crore = ₹13,74,727 crore
 
• ₹13,74,727 crore + ₹38,504 crore = ₹14,13,231 crore
 
• ₹14,13,231 crore + ₹13,439 crore = ₹14,26,670 crore
 
 

**Therefore, the correct value of GDP at factor cost is ₹14,26,670 crore.**
